CLN-001.name: Abnormal clinical measurement
CLN-001.description: A clinical measurement is outside its configured threshold.

CLN-002.name: Abnormal vital sign
CLN-002.description: One or more vital signs are outside their configured limits.

GAP-001.name: Overdue follow-up
GAP-001.description: The configured continuity interval has been exceeded.

GAP-002.name: Missed appointment
GAP-002.description: A recent appointment was recorded as missed.

UTL-001.name: High emergency utilization
UTL-001.description: Recent emergency-department utilization met the configured threshold.

UTL-002.name: Recent inpatient utilization
UTL-002.description: Recent inpatient utilization met the configured threshold.

clinical_continuity.name: Clinical concern with continuity gap
clinical_continuity.implication: Clinical concern is paired with a meaningful continuity gap.

recommended_actions.action: Review the active clinical findings and arrange appropriate follow-up.
Support appointment access when a continuity barrier is identified.

clinical_utilization.name: Clinical concern with utilization signal
clinical_utilization.implication: Clinical concern is accompanied by recent utilization activity.

recommended_actions.action: Review current clinical status alongside recent utilization.
Review the member for applicable care-management workflow.

chronic_navigation.name: Chronic-condition navigation context
chronic_navigation.implication: A configured chronic-condition context is present and may warrant navigation review.

recommended_actions.action: Review the navigation pathway and verify applicable member context.

clinical_assessment.name: Clinical review capability
clinical_assessment.purpose: Evaluate configured clinical measurements and return decision-relevant findings.

care_gap_assessment.name: Care gap review capability
care_gap_assessment.purpose: Evaluate follow-up recency and appointment continuity.

utilization_assessment.name: Utilization review capability
utilization_assessment.purpose: Evaluate recent emergency and inpatient activity against configured windows.

plan_context.name: Plan context capability
plan_context.purpose: Provide member enrollment context for assessments that require plan context.

careops_supervisor.name: CareOps Supervisor
careops_supervisor.purpose: Route an overall member assessment through the minimum useful deterministic capabilities and coordinate final synthesis.

care_gap_specialist.name: Care Gap Review Agent
care_gap_specialist.purpose: Produce a focused continuity and follow-up assessment.

navigation_specialist.name: Navigation Review Agent
navigation_specialist.purpose: Produce a focused navigation assessment using the evidence and policy required for navigation review.

overall.name: Overall Member Assessment
overall.description: A cross-domain member assessment coordinated by the CareOps Supervisor.

clinical.name: Clinical Review
clinical.description: A focused review of active clinical findings.

care_gap.name: Care Gap Review
care_gap.description: A focused review of continuity and follow-up signals.

utilization.name: Utilization Review
utilization.description: A focused review of recent emergency and inpatient utilization.

navigation.name: Navigation Review
navigation.description: A focused navigation review that uses its required clinical, continuity and plan context.

audiences.member: Plain-language explanation of what was found and what happens next.
audiences.care_team: Clinical and continuity context for operational review.
audiences.navigator: Navigation context, verification considerations and pathway relevance.
audiences.health_plan: Concise workflow context for plan operations.
